stationContext: Stasiun Tegalluar (Tegalluar Summarecon) is the Bandung-area terminus of the Whoosh Jakarta-Bandung high-speed railway, located in Cibiru Hilir, Cileunyi, Kabupaten Bandung, Jawa Barat, next to the Summarecon Bandung development and served by KCIC. KCIC's official press release describes Depo Tegalluar in Kabupaten Bandung as the maintenance and operations base for the KCIC400AF trainsets, listing seven technical areas and no crew lodging.

missingInfo: No official KCIC source (kcic.co.id press release, ticket.kcic.co.id, or official Whoosh site) was found that identifies any crew/official accommodation at Tegalluar. The official Depo Tegalluar press release lists only seven technical areas (Dynamic Monitor Shed, Stabling Zone, Temporary Repair & Loading Wheel-Set, Train Washing, Dynamic Debugging Zone, Rescue Facility, Joint Workshop) and mentions no mess, dormitory or crew lodging. Therefore no property is classified VERIFIED_OFFICIAL_KCIC.

Verified room counts, bed counts and capacity suitable for crew blocks for every property (Grand Cordela's 143 rooms is the only operator-published room count found; Bali World's 120 rooms appears only in an OTA description).

Official property websites for Bali World Hotel, Tamansari Panoramic Apartment, The Suites @Metro, De'Kayakini Hotel and Mouza Guest House (addresses for Bali World and Tamansari Panoramic are listing-confirmed, but no first-party site was fetched); Booking.com, RedDoorz, Traveloka and tiket.com pages returned bot challenges or HTTP 403.

kcicDataRequests: Does KCIC operate or contract any crew accommodation (mess, dormitory, guesthouse or hotel block) at or near Stasiun Tegalluar Summarecon or Depo Tegalluar? Provide an official written statement or press release reference.
If yes: official name, full address, coordinates, number of buildings/floors/rooms/beds, capacity, and the operating or contracting entity.
If accommodation is contracted from a public hotel: which properties, contract period, allocated room counts, agreed rates, and the KCIC contract owner/contact.
Crew rest facilities inside Depo Tegalluar (if any) and whether they are permitted for overnight stays, with capacity and access rules.
KCIC contact person and department responsible for crew accommodation at the Bandung/Tegalluar end (name, role, phone, email).
Any KCIC-approved transport arrangement between Stasiun Tegalluar / Depo Tegalluar and crew lodging, including distances and travel times.
Permission and usage rights for any official KCIC photographs of crew accommodation facilities.
